scope: Read-only, fixed-scope production inventory for the two isolated G1 MySQL instances. It uses fixed paths and fixed argv arrays, never a shell, never a caller-supplied path, and no database credential. Privileged database facts and restore proof are reported as UNKNOWN/NOT_PROVEN, never inferred.
not_included: database credentials, option files with credentials, or a MySQL connection
shell access, arbitrary command execution, or caller-supplied paths
